On the sign-in screen tap \"Forgot password?\", enter your email, answer your security question and choose a new password. If your account has no security question, ask an administrator to reset it.
How do I submit a ticket?
Tap the + button on your dashboard, enter a title and description, pick a category and priority (the app suggests one) and attach a file if it helps. Then tap submit.
How long until my ticket is handled?
Targets depend on priority: Critical 4 hours, High 24 hours, Medium 72 hours, Low 120 hours. Overdue tickets are flagged for the support team.
My Wi-Fi or VPN keeps disconnecting
Restart your device, forget and re-join the Wi-Fi network, and update the VPN app. If it still drops, submit a ticket in the Network category.
Restart it, close apps you are not using, free up storage space and install pending updates. If it is still slow, submit a Hardware or Software ticket.
How do I rate a ticket or see its history?
Open the ticket from your dashboard. The history shows every status change and assignment. Once the ticket is Resolved, the person who opened it can give a 1 to 5 star rating.

Kgotla konope ya + letlakaleng la gago, tsenya sehlogo le tlhaloso, kgetha mohuta le bohlokwa (aplikheišene e a šišinya) gomme o tsenye faele ge e thuša. Ke moka kgotla romela.

Minkarhi yi ya hi nkoka: Lowu Tlakukeke tiawara ta 4, Ehenhla tiawara ta 24, Exikarhi tiawara ta 72, Ehansi tiawara ta 120. Omu tikiti leti hundzeke nkarhi ti kombisiwa eka ntlawa wa nseketelo.

Yi sungule nakambe, pfala tiapp leti u nga ti tirhisiko, ntshunxa ndhawu ya vuhlayiselo u tlhela u nghenisa swiantswiso. Loko yi ha hlwela, rhumela tikiti ya Hardware kumbe Software.
Ndzi nyika tikiti mavonelo kumbe ndzi vona matimu ya yona ku ya hi ndlela yihi?
